      void drawCard(Player player, boolean hiddenStackIndicator) throws RemoteException
      This method simulates the process of drawing a card from the hidden stack
      Parameters:
      player - who is drawing a card
      hiddenStackIndicator - if the card is taken from the hidden or open stack

    • throwCard

      void throwCard(Player player, int cardId, int playerId) throws RemoteException
      This method simulates the process of putting one card to the open stack
      Parameters:
      player - who is throwing a card.
      cardId - is the id of the card, which will be put on the stack.
      playerId - is the player to be skipped, in case a skip card is played
      Throws:
      RemoteException

    • playCard

      void playCard(Player player, int cardId, int filingId, boolean low) throws RemoteException
      This method simulates the process of one player putting a card to a filing.
      Parameters:
      player - the active player
      cardId - the id of the card to put on the table
      filingId - the id number of the filing where the card should be added.
      low - indicates, in the case of a street, if the card should added at the start or end.
      Throws:
      RemoteException

    • layCards

      void layCards(Player player, int[] cardIds) throws RemoteException
      This method simulates the process of open up a new filing.
      Parameters:
      player - who is active at the moment
      cardIds - the id numbers of the cards to put down.
      Throws:
      RemoteException
